findings.title: Nil Model dereference in view()
findings.message: Model may be nil; Scene.Validate has a nil receiver check, so Mount returns nil. However Sync and changed call v.Model.Validate/Touch which are nil-safe, but view() calls v.Model.Camera.SetView directly and dereferences nil Model.
findings.suggestion: Guard v.Model == nil in view() and other direct dereferences.

findings.title: cubeGesture state not reset
findings.message: A cube-gesture click (pointer down on the cube) sets cubeGesture, but on a non-drag release a miss of cube faces still returns true and never selects. On cancel after a drag, state is restored, but cubeGesture is not reset on PointerUp when no gesture was active (stale flag across gestures if Begin fails).
findings.suggestion: Reset cubeGesture when Begin returns false and on End/Cancel.

findings.title: Buffer resize may reuse stale smaller buffer
findings.message: The vertex and index buffers are requested by label with a new size on each rebuild. If Resources.Buffer returns the cached buffer when the label exists, a larger mesh will not fit and WriteBuffer will fail. Also release() just nils the buffers without releasing them.
findings.suggestion: Verify that Resources.Buffer reallocates on size change; otherwise release and recreate buffers explicitly.
